datasets.method: Manual source-black-outline interpretation on the exact original embedded2021 municipal figure79 JPEG. Manually selected source-stroke seeds guide connected dark source-pixel paths; every dense vertex is an actual source pixel(maxRGB45) and every step is an8-neighbor source-pixel step. datasets.method: Manual interpretation of separately labelled fine-quarter outlines on the exact original embedded JPEG of the 2021 consultation-draft municipal figure 81. Manually identified source-stroke seeds guide continuous 8-neighbor source-pixel paths. For the literal-source layer every dense vertex has maxRGB <= 45. Only exactly collinear vertices are removed. A metric affine fit in EOV/EPSG:23700 using five literal contemporary OSM-node coordinates and manually placed approximate old-image road junctions georeferences the source pixels; the result is converted to WGS84. No current-road replacement, source-frame closure, arbitrary chord, buffer, geometric snapping or geometry repair is used.

datasets.method: Literal source-vector circuit extraction from the single-page Tatabánya Városrészek településrendezési szempontú lehatárolása map, annex 3 of municipal regulation 8/2018 (IV.19.). Original decimal PDF path operands and graphics matrices are evaluated exactly, rather than snapping MuPDF float32 endpoint approximations. Every exported edge is an actual selected source line item, possibly reversed. Explicit source subcircuits omit documented out-and-back nonboundary strokes; no buffer, make_valid, invented closing edge, smoothing, clipping or geographical snapping is used. The frozen earlier municipal-outline affine georegistration into EOV/EPSG:23700 is preserved and inverse-projected into WGS84. Historical source overlaps and small differences from the current OSM city boundary remain unmodified and recorded.
